meta.landingTitle: Nablix — Markdown notes with handwriting, runnable code & your own AI
meta.landingDesc: Nablix is a local-first note app for Windows that fuses Markdown, handwritten ink, executable code and BYOK AI. No account, no cloud, no telemetry — your notes stay on your machine.
meta.pricingDesc: Start free with 20 pages and every core feature. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited pages, inline AI completion and the interactive Page Map — monthly, yearly, or pay-once Lifetime.
meta.privacyDesc: How Nablix handles your data: locally. Exactly what leaves your device, when, and why — the complete, short list.
meta.termsDesc: The terms that govern your use of Nablix: license, purchases, refunds, code execution and your responsibilities.

features.heading: One page. Every way you think.
features.sub: Stop juggling a notes app, a whiteboard, a LaTeX editor and a REPL. Nablix folds them into a single fast workspace.

items.title: Infinite handwriting canvas
items.desc: Think in ink on boundless canvases — as standalone whiteboard pages or as blocks embedded right inside your Markdown.

items.title: Code that actually runs
items.desc: Execute Python, TypeScript, Rust, C++ and 17+ languages inline, Jupyter-style. Output lands right under the block.

items.title: Ink → LaTeX, image → Markdown
items.desc: Handwrite an equation and let AI turn it into clean KaTeX. Paste a screenshot, get editable Markdown back.

items.title: A graph, not a pile
items.desc: Bidirectional [[wiki links]], hover-glossary definitions and a constellation Page Map turn scattered notes into a second brain.

items.title: Your AI, your key
items.desc: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. Chat with page context, autocomplete as you type, connect agents over MCP. Keys never leave your machine.

items.title: Local-first. Actually.
items.desc: Built with Rust + Tauri: instant startup, fully offline, zero telemetry. Notes live in plain folders you own and can export anytime.

dive1.title: Math-grade notes, ink included
dive1.desc: KaTeX math with custom macros, definition blocks with hover tooltips, columns and toggles — and when typing is too slow for the idea, just draw it.

points.html: Handwriting canvas as full pages or inline blocks inside any note
AI ink translation — handwriting becomes Markdown or LaTeX in one tap
KaTeX everywhere: inline math, math blocks and reusable macros
Definition blocks — hover any reference to see its definition card

dive2.title: A notebook that executes
dive2.desc: Code blocks are not screenshots of your work — they are your work. Run them in place and keep results next to the reasoning.

points.html: 17+ languages: Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C, C++, Go, R, Ruby and more
Inline output right under the block — rerun anytime
Per-page workspaces: every page maps to its own folder; open a terminal right there
Runs on your local toolchain — no cloud sandbox, no upload

dive3.title: AI on your terms
dive3.desc: Nablix has no AI subscription and no middleman server. Plug in your own OpenAI or Anthropic key — or wire your favorite coding agent straight into your notes via MCP.

points.html: AI chat that sees the current page — unlimited, even on Free
Built-in MCP server: Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf can read and edit your notes
Scoped by design — agents only see the page and workspace you have open

privacyStrip.title: No account. No cloud. No telemetry.
privacyStrip.desc: Nablix talks to the internet in exactly three cases: your AI calls (your key, your provider), license activation (Lemon Squeezy) and update checks (GitHub). That is the entire list — and the privacy policy is short enough to actually read.

items.a: Yes — the Free plan is not a trial. You get 20 pages, one workspace folder, and almost every feature: the full editor, canvas, code execution, math, graph view, search, export and unlimited BYOK AI chat. You only upgrade when you need more room.
Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) today. The codebase is cross-platform and a macOS build is planned once the Windows version is rock solid.
In ordinary folders on your own disk — pages are files you can open, back up, sync or export with any tool you like. Nothing is uploaded to us. There is no 'us' server at all.

items.q: Do I need an AI subscription?
items.a: No. AI features are optional and BYOK (bring your own key): you connect your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key and pay your provider only for what you use. Everything else works without any key.

Nablix ships a built-in MCP server, so tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf can read and edit your notes as first-class context. Access is scoped to the page and workspace you currently have open — nothing else is exposed.

items.q: What happens when I hit the 20-page limit?
items.a: Nothing scary. Your notes always remain viewable, editable and exportable — Free limits only stop you from creating new pages beyond 20. Delete pages to get back under the limit, or upgrade to Pro.

Early builds are not yet code-signed (a signing certificate is planned before 1.0). Every installer is built automatically from tagged source by GitHub Actions, and you can inspect each release on the releases page. Click 'More info' → 'Run anyway' to proceed.

pricing.assure2: Secure checkout, taxes & invoices by Lemon Squeezy
pricing.assure3: Cancel anytime — your data is never locked

faq.a: Checkout and billing are handled by Lemon Squeezy, our merchant of record — they process payment, taxes and invoices. You receive a license key by email within minutes; paste it into Nablix (Settings → License) and you are done.

faq.q: Can I use one license on multiple devices?
faq.a: Yes. Your license can be deactivated on one device and activated on another at any time, right from the app. It is licensed per person, not per machine.
A one-time payment that unlocks every Pro feature permanently, including future updates of the app. It is not a subscription and there is nothing to renew.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel Pro?
faq.a: Your notes are never held hostage. Everything remains viewable, editable and exportable. If you are over the Free limits you simply cannot create new pages or folders until you are back under them — or until you upgrade again.
Lemon Squeezy calculates and adds any applicable VAT or sales tax at checkout based on your country, and handles all tax paperwork as merchant of record.
If Nablix is not for you, email us within 14 days of purchase and we will refund you in full — no forms, no interrogation.

faq.q: Is there a Microsoft Store version?
faq.a: A Store edition is planned. Store sandbox rules disallow launching external processes, so code execution is exclusive to the official edition you download here. Licenses purchased on this site activate the official edition.

faq.q: Do I need to pay extra for AI?
faq.a: Nablix never charges for AI. You bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key and pay your provider directly for usage — typically pennies for note-taking workloads. AI chat is unlimited on every plan, including Free.
